description: Dark elf clients: terse, conditional, watchful. Deals come with ifs and no names.

d-hail: You're the one with the hold.
d-intro: I work for {faction}, or I do today.
{faction} wants this done, and wants it not to be theirs.
I'm {client}. I'll be someone else next month.
I don't have a client. I have an interest.
You don't need to know who I serve.
d-frame: It's simple if nothing goes wrong.
It's easy for someone who doesn't ask.
Take it or leave it, but decide now.
d-clock: You have {deadline}, if nobody else is faster.
If you're slow, it's over before you start.
d-clock2: Don't make me find someone else.
d-stakes: Other people are looking for the same thing.
If you're late, someone else has already bought it.
The longer it takes, the more people know.
I only get this chance once.
d-offer: I'll give you {reward}, once I've seen it's finished.
d-if: Do it quietly and there may be more.
If you ask what's in it for me, the price goes down.
If it goes well, I might call again.
d-caution: Don't trust the first friendly face.
Someone will notice. Don't be there when they do.
If you see a way out, take it.
Keep the lights off and the comms quieter.
Trust nothing you're told on the way.
d-conseq: If it fails, I don't know you.
I won't come looking, if you vanish.
If someone asks, you were never here.
If you talk, I'll hear of it.
d-send: Don't come back unless it's done.
d-part: You'll hear from me, or you won't.
